readout_other: Auditory brainstem responses (ABR); laminar LFP, CSD and multiunit activity in auditory cortex; acoustic emission sensor on skull
direction_notes: Tapered-envelope ultrasound evoked laminar LFP and multiunit responses in auditory cortex while reducing or abolishing ABRs; responses persisted in ototoxically deafened mice.
safety_notes: Measured ISPTA was compared with the FDA-recommended limit; no adverse-event assessment described.

exposures.label: Continuous-wave 500 kHz bursts with 0, 20 or 50 % tapered window, left auditory cortex

device.model: V301-SU planar transducer with custom-made waveguide

timing.protocol_description: Single continuous-wave bursts of 0.5, 1, 5, 10 or 20 ms with sinusoidal onset/offset windows totalling 0, 20 or 50 % of the duration (15 combinations). Repetitive pulsed stimulation was deliberately not used. Intertrial interval not stated for ultrasound; 512 repetitions per condition for MUA.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Sixteen C57BL/6J mice (nine males and seven females; Japan SLC, Japan; 6–10 weeks old) were used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: the transducer was excited at the fundamental frequency of 0.5 MHz and driven by input voltage amplitudes ranging from 0.5 to 250 V (1.0 to 500 Vpp).
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: An ultrasound transducer (V301-SU; Olympus, USA) attached to a custom-made waveguide
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: An ultrasound transducer (V301-SU; Olympus, USA) attached to a custom-made waveguide

source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.ispta_w_cm2: a constant ultrasound intensity (67 kPa; I<sub>SPTA</sub> $= 1 5 2 \mathrm { m W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 } )$ was applied at the waveguide surface

flags.reason: 67 kPa is at the waveguide surface; 32.2 kPa was measured 8 mm from the waveguide surface (where brain lies); four pressures 32.2-218 kPa were piloted. Hydrophone in water tank.
152 mW/cm2 converted to 0.152 W/cm2; tied to 67 kPa at waveguide surface.
Continuous wave with amplitude-tapered onset/offset (window); classed continuous as each stimulus is one uninterrupted burst, but envelope shaping is the independent variable.
16 normal-hearing mice; 4 further mice were ototoxically deafened and it is unclear whether these are part of the 16. Analysed n varies (5, 4, 3).
Skull attenuation stated to be negligible and ignored; no in situ values.
Sham was 0 V input to the transducer (0 kPa-driven stimulation).
